name: Juggloria
summary:
Welcome to Juggloria, a vibrant virtual reality circus where every throw, catch, and carefully timed move brings you closer to becoming the star of the show.

Put your coordination and accuracy to the test across six varied circus acts. Send objects through rings, strike numbered targets, complete fast-paced deliveries, overcome maze-like challenges, maintain your balance, and develop your juggling skills in a responsive, physics-driven arena.
